description: Court deadline calculator (FRCP 6) — Federal court deadline calculator using FRCP 6(a) / FRAP 26(a) counting: excludes the trigger day, counts calendar days, rolls a last day on a weekend or legal holiday (11 federal holidays incl. observed days) to the next court day (earlier for periods counted backward), and adds 3 days for mail/clerk/other service under FRCP 6(d). date= plus rule= preset (answer, answer-waiver, answer-us, reply-counterclaim, amend, jury-demand, magistrate-objection, new-trial, alter-judgment, jmol, fees, appeal, appeal-us, appeal-criminal, summary-judgment, removal, expert-disclosure, pretrial-disclosures, or all) or days=N with direction=after|before; service=electronic|personal|mail|clerk|other; extra_holidays= for state or declared holidays. Shows every counting step. Not legal advice. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
